hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: LaunchpadHook charges a configurable ETH fee (0.3%–1.5%) on every swap across all four exact-in/exact-out quadrants, taking fees via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. Sells during an optional launch window pay a higher linearly-decaying fee; fees are distributed among the token creator, a land fund, and a treasury.
